excerpt: Infineon Technologies AG (FSE: IFX / OTCQX: IFNNY) and GlobalFoundries (Nasdaq: GFS) (GF) today announced a new multi-year agreement on the supply of Infineon’s AURIX™ TC3x 40 nanometer automotive microcontrollers
notes: GF manufactures Infineon's 40nm AURIX microcontrollers (GF said it secures Infineon as a key long-term customer). 40nm is mature node, hence logic-foundry-mature.
